Visit note | 2025-08-03 03:00 PM | Dr. Saiful Alam, Endocrinology | Patient: Yusuf Gazi, 41, male. Mr. Gazi attends for his ongoing review and reports hating the heat, a racing heart, and shaky hands. These issues began after a stressful family event in Narayanganj. He works as a construction worker and has Bronchial asthma. He reports no chest pain or eye discomfort. On examination: pulse 116 bpm, BP 126/84 mmHg, weight 50 kg. His neck is soft with no obvious goitre. Assessment: Hyperthyroidism. Plan: a prescription was issued. He was advised to avoid excess tea and coffee and to rest when the heart races. Follow-up in 4 weeks with thyroid function tests.
